title: Reviewer qualification criteria + onboarding (incl. medical-interpreter tier)
context: Repeatable quality depends on objective, published criteria for who may review, including a medical-capable tier for Tier-C content. This document defines those criteria and the onboarding/sign-off workflow. It builds on the reviewer checklist.
objective: Publish reviewer qualification criteria (incl. medical-interpreter tier) and the onboarding/sign-off workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Defines objective criteria for a qualified speaker (native/near-native target language) and for the medical-capable tier (bilingual clinician or qualified medical interpreter), plus onboarding/sign-off workflow and a COI declaration

Defines reviewer independence (drafting human is not sole reviewer), the mandatory second reviewer for Tier B/C, back-translation QA as a required gate for Tier C, and clinician sign-off for medical-critical phrases
Defines the disagreement/conflict-resolution rule (reconcile, escalate, conservative reading wins; recorded in review.yaml)
